title.en: MABA Suitez: Is It Worth Buying? A Plain Guide for Buyers
title.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 值得买吗？给买家的简单分析
title.ms: MABA Suitez: Berbaloi Dibeli? Panduan Ringkas untuk Pembeli
title.ja: MABA Suitez は買い？購入者向けのわかりやすいガイド
title.ko: MABA Suitez, 살 만할까? 구매자를 위한 쉬운 가이드

intro.en: MABA Suitez is a two-tower serviced apartment project on Jalan Hang Jebat, right beside Menara Merdeka Maybank and about 160m from Merdeka MRT. Here is what you get, who it suits and what to compare before you decide.
intro.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 是位于 Jalan Hang Jebat 的两栋服务式公寓，就在 Menara Merdeka Maybank 旁边，离 Merdeka MRT 约 160 米。这篇文章整理了项目内容、适合哪些买家，以及决定前可以比较的地方。
intro.ms: MABA Suitez ialah projek pangsapuri servis dua menara di Jalan Hang Jebat, bersebelahan Menara Merdeka Maybank dan kira-kira 160m dari MRT Merdeka. Ini yang anda dapat, siapa yang sesuai dan apa yang perlu dibandingkan sebelum membuat keputusan.
intro.ja: MABA Suitez は Jalan Hang Jebat にある2棟のサービスアパートメントで、Menara Merdeka Maybank のすぐ隣、Merdeka MRT から約160mです。プロジェクトの内容、向いている購入者、決める前に比較したい点をまとめました。
intro.ko: MABA Suitez는 Jalan Hang Jebat에 있는 2개 동의 서비스 아파트로, Menara Merdeka Maybank 바로 옆, Merdeka MRT에서 약 160m 거리에 있습니다. 프로젝트 내용, 어떤 구매자에게 맞는지, 결정 전에 비교할 점을 정리했습니다.

paragraphs.en: MABA Suitez is developed by EXSIM together with the Malaysian Basketball Association (MABA), on the site of MABA's old building. It has 914 units in two towers, Tower A with 54 storeys and Tower B with 50 storeys, on 1.328 acres of land.
paragraphs.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 由 EXSIM 和马来西亚篮球总会（MABA）合作开发，地段就是 MABA 原本的大楼。项目有两栋楼，共 914 个单位：A 栋 54 层，B 栋 50 层，占地 1.328 英亩。
paragraphs.ms: MABA Suitez dibangunkan oleh EXSIM bersama Persatuan Bola Keranjang Malaysia (MABA), di tapak bangunan lama MABA. Ia mempunyai 914 unit dalam dua menara, Menara A setinggi 54 tingkat dan Menara B 50 tingkat, di atas tanah seluas 1.328 ekar.
paragraphs.ja: MABA Suitez は EXSIM とマレーシア・バスケットボール協会（MABA）が共同で開発し、敷地は MABA の旧ビルの場所です。2棟で計914戸、A棟は54階、B棟は50階、敷地は1.328エーカーです。
paragraphs.ko: MABA Suitez는 EXSIM과 말레이시아 농구협회(MABA)가 공동 개발하며, 부지는 MABA의 옛 건물 자리입니다. 2개 동에 총 914세대이며, A동은 54층, B동은 50층, 부지는 1.328에이커입니다.

paragraphs.en: The groundbreaking was held at the end of November 2025, and completion is expected in 2031. MABA will have its new home in the building, including a half court for 3x3 basketball, and the podium on Level 6 has a basketball court for residents.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 项目在 2025 年 11 月底动工，预计 2031 年完工。MABA 的新总部也会设在这里，包括一个 3x3 篮球半场；第 6 层的平台也有给住户用的篮球场。
paragraphs.ms: Majlis pecah tanah diadakan pada akhir November 2025, dan projek dijangka siap pada 2031. MABA akan berpangkalan di bangunan ini, termasuk gelanggang separuh untuk bola keranjang 3x3, dan podium di Tingkat 6 mempunyai gelanggang bola keranjang untuk penduduk.
paragraphs.ja: 2025年11月末に起工し、2031年の完成が見込まれています。MABA の新本部もこの建物に入り、3x3バスケットボール用のハーフコートがあります。6階のポディウムには住民用のバスケットボールコートもあります。
paragraphs.ko: 2025년 11월 말에 착공했으며 2031년 완공 예정입니다. MABA의 새 본부도 이 건물에 들어서며 3x3 농구용 하프 코트가 있습니다. 6층 포디움에는 입주민용 농구 코트도 있습니다.

paragraphs.en: This is the strongest point of the project. Merdeka MRT station on the Kajang line is about 160m away, around a two-minute walk. From there, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur is one station away, and TRX and KL Sentral (via Muzium Negara) are two stations away.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 地点是这个项目最大的优势。Kajang 线的 Merdeka MRT 站约 160 米，走路大约两分钟。从这里坐 MRT，一站到 Pavilion Kuala Lumpur，两站到 TRX，经 Muzium Negara 两站到 KL Sentral。
paragraphs.ms: Ini kelebihan terbesar projek ini. Stesen MRT Merdeka di laluan Kajang kira-kira 160m jauhnya, lebih kurang dua minit berjalan kaki. Dari situ, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur hanya satu stesen, manakala TRX dan KL Sentral (melalui Muzium Negara) dua stesen.
paragraphs.ja: 立地はこのプロジェクト最大の強みです。Kajang 線の Merdeka MRT 駅まで約160m、徒歩約2分。そこから Pavilion Kuala Lumpur まで1駅、TRX と KL Sentral（Muzium Negara 経由）まで2駅です。
paragraphs.ko: 위치가 이 프로젝트의 가장 큰 장점입니다. Kajang 노선 Merdeka MRT역까지 약 160m, 도보 약 2분입니다. 여기서 Pavilion Kuala Lumpur까지 1정거장, TRX와 KL Sentral(Muzium Negara 경유)까지 2정거장입니다.

paragraphs.en: Around the project you have Merdeka 118 and Menara Merdeka Maybank, Stadium Negara, Pasar Seni and the old city centre, with the KL City Centre skyline close by.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 项目附近有 Merdeka 118 和 Menara Merdeka Maybank、Stadium Negara、Pasar Seni 和旧城区，离 KL City Centre 也很近。
paragraphs.ms: Di sekitar projek terdapat Merdeka 118 dan Menara Merdeka Maybank, Stadium Negara, Pasar Seni dan pusat bandar lama, dengan KL City Centre berdekatan.
paragraphs.ja: 周辺には Merdeka 118 と Menara Merdeka Maybank、Stadium Negara、Pasar Seni、旧市街があり、KL City Centre も近くです。
paragraphs.ko: 주변에는 Merdeka 118과 Menara Merdeka Maybank, Stadium Negara, Pasar Seni, 구시가지가 있으며 KL City Centre와도 가깝습니다.

paragraphs.en: There are three main layouts: Type A, a 323 sqft office-suite studio; Type B, a 484 sqft suite with a 1+1 room; and Type C, a 657 sqft dual-key suite with one room and two bathrooms. Prices start from RM699,000 (gross), which works out to about RM2,164 – RM2,701 per sqft.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 主要有三种户型：Type A 是 323 平方尺的办公室套房；Type B 是 484 平方尺、1+1 房的套房；Type C 是 657 平方尺的双钥匙套房，1 房 2 浴。价格从 RM699,000 起（Gross），大约每平方尺 RM2,164 – RM2,701。
paragraphs.ms: Terdapat tiga susun atur utama: Jenis A, studio suite pejabat 323 kaki persegi; Jenis B, suite 484 kaki persegi dengan bilik 1+1; dan Jenis C, suite dual key 657 kaki persegi dengan satu bilik dan dua bilik mandi. Harga bermula dari RM699,000 (kasar), kira-kira RM2,164 – RM2,701 sekaki persegi.
paragraphs.ja: 主な間取りは3つ：Type A は323平方フィートのオフィススイート、Type B は484平方フィートの1+1ルーム、Type C は657平方フィートのデュアルキーで1部屋・バス2つ。価格は RM699,000（グロス）からで、平方フィート単価は約 RM2,164 – RM2,701 です。
paragraphs.ko: 주요 타입은 세 가지입니다. Type A는 323평방피트 오피스 스위트, Type B는 484평방피트 1+1룸, Type C는 657평방피트 듀얼키로 방 1개와 욕실 2개입니다. 가격은 RM699,000(총액)부터이며 평방피트당 약 RM2,164 – RM2,701입니다.

paragraphs.en: Type C is the most common layout, with 377 units, followed by Type B with 288 and Type A with 249. Sky facilities are on Levels 47 and 50 of Tower B and Levels 53 to 53A of Tower A.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type C 数量最多，有 377 个单位；Type B 有 288 个，Type A 有 249 个。空中设施在 B 栋第 47 和 50 层，以及 A 栋第 53 至 53A 层。
paragraphs.ms: Jenis C paling banyak, dengan 377 unit, diikuti Jenis B dengan 288 dan Jenis A dengan 249. Kemudahan langit terletak di Tingkat 47 dan 50 Menara B serta Tingkat 53 hingga 53A Menara A.
paragraphs.ja: 最も多いのは Type C の377戸で、Type B が288戸、Type A が249戸です。スカイ施設は B棟の47階と50階、A棟の53階から53A階にあります。
paragraphs.ko: 가장 많은 타입은 Type C로 377세대이며, Type B 288세대, Type A 249세대입니다. 스카이 시설은 B동 47층과 50층, A동 53층~53A층에 있습니다.

paragraphs.en: MABA Suitez suits investors who want a city-centre unit next to the MRT at a lower entry price, business owners who want a small office suite in the centre of KL, and single professionals or couples who want a compact home. The dual-key Type C suits owners who want flexibility, living in one part and renting out the other.
paragraphs.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 适合想用较低入场价，在市中心 MRT 旁边买单位的投资者；想在 KL 市中心有一间小办公室的老板；以及想要精致小单位的单身人士或情侣。双钥匙的 Type C 适合想要弹性的业主，可以一边自住，一边出租。
paragraphs.ms: MABA Suitez sesuai untuk pelabur yang mahukan unit pusat bandar bersebelahan MRT pada harga permulaan yang lebih rendah, pemilik perniagaan yang mahukan suite pejabat kecil di tengah KL, serta profesional bujang atau pasangan yang mahukan rumah kompak. Jenis C dual key sesuai untuk pemilik yang mahukan fleksibiliti, tinggal di satu bahagian dan menyewakan bahagian lain.
paragraphs.ja: MABA Suitez は、手頃な価格から MRT 隣の都心物件を持ちたい投資家、KL 中心部に小さなオフィスが欲しい経営者、コンパクトな住まいを求める単身者やカップルに向いています。デュアルキーの Type C は、片方に住みもう片方を貸すなど柔軟に使いたいオーナーに向いています。
paragraphs.ko: MABA Suitez는 낮은 진입 가격으로 MRT 옆 도심 세대를 원하는 투자자, KL 중심가에 작은 사무실을 원하는 사업주, 컴팩트한 집을 원하는 1인 가구나 커플에게 적합합니다. 듀얼키 Type C는 한쪽에 살고 다른 쪽을 임대하는 등 유연하게 쓰고 싶은 분께 맞습니다.

h2.en: What to compare before you decide
h2.zh-CN: 决定前可以比较的地方
h2.ms: Apa yang perlu dibandingkan sebelum membuat keputusan
h2.ja: 決める前に比較したい点

paragraphs.en: The units are compact, from 323 to 657 sqft with up to one room, so families who need more bedrooms may want to look at larger layouts elsewhere. The project is leasehold, car parks are sold separately from the units, and the maintenance fee is RM0.99 per sqft, about RM320 a month for Type A.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 单位面积是 323 至 657 平方尺，最多 1 间房，需要更多房间的家庭可以多看其他项目的大户型。项目是租赁地契（Leasehold），车位不包在单位价格里，管理费是每平方尺 RM0.99，Type A 每月约 RM320。
paragraphs.ms: Unit-unitnya kompak, dari 323 hingga 657 kaki persegi dengan sehingga satu bilik, jadi keluarga yang perlukan lebih banyak bilik boleh melihat susun atur yang lebih besar di tempat lain. Projek ini pajakan, tempat letak kereta dijual berasingan, dan yuran penyelenggaraan RM0.99 sekaki persegi, kira-kira RM320 sebulan untuk Jenis A.
paragraphs.ja: 住戸は323〜657平方フィート、最大1部屋とコンパクトなので、部屋数が必要なご家族は他のプロジェクトの広い間取りも見てみるとよいでしょう。リースホールドで、駐車場は住戸と別売り、管理費は平方フィートあたり RM0.99（Type A で月約 RM320）です。
paragraphs.ko: 세대는 323~657평방피트, 최대 방 1개로 컴팩트하므로 방이 더 필요한 가족은 다른 프로젝트의 큰 타입도 살펴보면 좋습니다. 리스홀드이며 주차는 세대와 별도 판매, 관리비는 평방피트당 RM0.99(Type A 기준 월 약 RM320)입니다.

paragraphs.en: For foreign buyers, the minimum price in Kuala Lumpur is RM1 million. The entry units are below this, while larger units can meet it, so check the exact unit before you book.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 外国买家在吉隆坡的最低购买价格是 RM100 万。入门单位低于这个价格，较大的单位可以达到，下订前要先确认实际单位。
paragraphs.ms: Bagi pembeli asing, harga minimum di Kuala Lumpur ialah RM1 juta. Unit permulaan di bawah paras ini, manakala unit yang lebih besar boleh mencapainya, jadi semak unit sebenar sebelum menempah.
paragraphs.ja: 外国人購入者のクアラルンプールでの最低価格は100万リンギットです。入門住戸はこれを下回りますが、広い住戸は条件を満たせるので、予約前に実際の住戸を確認してください。
paragraphs.ko: 외국인 구매자의 쿠알라룸푸르 최저 가격은 100만 링깃입니다. 기본 세대는 이보다 낮지만 큰 세대는 충족할 수 있으니 예약 전에 실제 세대를 확인하세요.

takeaway.en: MABA Suitez is about location: a new address beside Menara Merdeka Maybank, two minutes on foot from the MRT, with units from RM699,000 (gross). If a compact unit fits your plan, it is worth a close look. WhatsApp me and I will check the current prices and units for you.
takeaway.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 最大的价值是地点：就在 Menara Merdeka Maybank 旁边，走两分钟到 MRT，单位从 RM699,000 起（Gross）。如果小户型符合你的计划，值得仔细看看。WhatsApp 我，我帮你查最新价格和剩余单位。
takeaway.ms: Kelebihan MABA Suitez ialah lokasinya: alamat baharu bersebelahan Menara Merdeka Maybank, dua minit berjalan kaki ke MRT, dengan unit dari RM699,000 (kasar). Jika unit kompak sesuai dengan rancangan anda, ia berbaloi untuk dilihat dengan teliti. WhatsApp saya dan saya akan semak harga dan unit terkini untuk anda.
takeaway.ja: MABA Suitez の一番の価値は立地です。Menara Merdeka Maybank のすぐ隣、MRT まで徒歩2分、住戸は RM699,000（グロス）から。コンパクトな住戸が計画に合うなら、じっくり検討する価値があります。WhatsApp をいただければ、最新の価格と空き住戸をお調べします。
takeaway.ko: MABA Suitez의 가장 큰 가치는 위치입니다. Menara Merdeka Maybank 바로 옆, MRT까지 도보 2분, 세대는 RM699,000(총액)부터입니다. 컴팩트한 세대가 계획에 맞는다면 자세히 볼 만합니다. WhatsApp 주시면 최신 가격과 남은 세대를 확인해 드리겠습니다.

title.en: MABA Suitez Type A, B or C: Which Layout Fits You?
title.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 选 Type A、B 还是 C？哪个户型适合你
title.ms: MABA Suitez Jenis A, B atau C: Susun Atur Mana Sesuai untuk Anda?
title.ja: MABA Suitez は Type A、B、C のどれ？あなたに合う間取り
title.ko: MABA Suitez Type A, B, C 중 어떤 타입이 나에게 맞을까?

intro.en: MABA Suitez has three main layouts, from a 323 sqft office suite to a 657 sqft dual-key suite. They suit different plans, so here is a side-by-side look at size, number of units and monthly running costs.
intro.zh-CN: MABA Suitez 有三种主要户型，从 323 平方尺的办公室套房到 657 平方尺的双钥匙套房。不同户型适合不同的计划，这篇把面积、单位数量和每月开销放在一起比较。
intro.ms: MABA Suitez mempunyai tiga susun atur utama, dari suite pejabat 323 kaki persegi hingga suite dual key 657 kaki persegi. Setiap satu sesuai untuk rancangan berbeza, jadi ini perbandingan saiz, bilangan unit dan kos bulanan.
intro.ja: MABA Suitez には323平方フィートのオフィススイートから657平方フィートのデュアルキーまで、3つの主な間取りがあります。用途によって向き不向きがあるので、広さ、戸数、毎月のコストを並べて比較します。
intro.ko: MABA Suitez에는 323평방피트 오피스 스위트부터 657평방피트 듀얼키까지 세 가지 주요 타입이 있습니다. 용도에 따라 맞는 타입이 다르니 면적, 세대 수, 월 비용을 나란히 비교해 봅니다.

h2.zh-CN: Type A：323 平方尺办公室套房
h2.ms: Jenis A: suite pejabat 323 kaki persegi
h2.ja: Type A：323平方フィートのオフィススイート

paragraphs.en: Type A is a studio with a pantry and one bathroom, and it is the entry point into the project, from RM699,000 (gross). There are 249 Type A units across both towers.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type A 是开放式格局，有小厨房和 1 间浴室，是这个项目的入门单位，RM699,000 起（Gross）。两栋楼共有 249 个 Type A。
paragraphs.ms: Jenis A ialah studio dengan pantri dan satu bilik mandi, dan merupakan pintu masuk ke projek ini, dari RM699,000 (kasar). Terdapat 249 unit Jenis A di kedua-dua menara.
paragraphs.ja: Type A はパントリーとバス1つのスタジオで、このプロジェクトの入門住戸です。RM699,000（グロス）から。2棟で249戸あります。
paragraphs.ko: Type A는 팬트리와 욕실 1개가 있는 스튜디오로, 이 프로젝트의 입문 세대입니다. RM699,000(총액)부터이며 두 동에 249세대가 있습니다.

paragraphs.en: It suits a business owner who wants a small office in the city centre, or a buyer who wants the lowest entry price for a first city investment. The maintenance fee is about RM320 a month.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 适合想在市中心有一间小办公室的老板，或想用最低入场价做第一个城市投资的买家。管理费每月约 RM320。
paragraphs.ms: Ia sesuai untuk pemilik perniagaan yang mahukan pejabat kecil di pusat bandar, atau pembeli yang mahukan harga permulaan terendah untuk pelaburan bandar pertama. Yuran penyelenggaraan kira-kira RM320 sebulan.
paragraphs.ja: 都心に小さなオフィスが欲しい経営者や、最も手頃な価格で初めての都市投資をしたい方に向いています。管理費は月約 RM320 です。
paragraphs.ko: 도심에 작은 사무실을 원하는 사업주나, 가장 낮은 가격으로 첫 도심 투자를 하려는 분께 맞습니다. 관리비는 월 약 RM320입니다.

h2.zh-CN: Type B：484 平方尺，1+1 房
h2.ja: Type B：484平方フィート、1+1ルーム

paragraphs.en: Type B has a 1+1 room layout and one bathroom in 484 sqft. There are 288 Type B units. The extra room can be a study, a work corner or a small guest room.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type B 是 484 平方尺、1+1 房、1 间浴室，共有 288 个单位。多出来的小房间可以当书房、工作区或小客房。
paragraphs.ms: Jenis B mempunyai susun atur bilik 1+1 dan satu bilik mandi dalam 484 kaki persegi. Terdapat 288 unit Jenis B. Bilik tambahan boleh dijadikan bilik belajar, ruang kerja atau bilik tetamu kecil.
paragraphs.ja: Type B は484平方フィートで1+1ルーム、バス1つ。288戸あります。もう1つの小部屋は書斎、ワークスペース、小さな客間として使えます。
paragraphs.ko: Type B는 484평방피트에 1+1룸, 욕실 1개이며 288세대가 있습니다. 작은 방 하나는 서재, 작업 공간, 작은 손님방으로 쓸 수 있습니다.

paragraphs.en: It suits a single professional or a couple who want a separate room. The maintenance fee is about RM479 a month.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 适合想要独立房间的单身专业人士或情侣。管理费每月约 RM479。
paragraphs.ms: Ia sesuai untuk profesional bujang atau pasangan yang mahukan bilik berasingan. Yuran penyelenggaraan kira-kira RM479 sebulan.
paragraphs.ja: 個室が欲しい単身の社会人やカップルに向いています。管理費は月約 RM479 です。
paragraphs.ko: 별도의 방을 원하는 1인 직장인이나 커플에게 맞습니다. 관리비는 월 약 RM479입니다.

h2.zh-CN: Type C：657 平方尺双钥匙
h2.ms: Jenis C: dual key 657 kaki persegi
h2.ja: Type C：657平方フィートのデュアルキー

paragraphs.en: Type C is a dual-key suite with a living and dining area, one room and two bathrooms in 657 sqft. It is the most common layout, with 377 units, and it also comes in a mirrored version, Type C (M).
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type C 是双钥匙套房，657 平方尺，有客厅和饭厅、1 间房、2 间浴室。这是数量最多的户型，有 377 个单位，另外还有左右对调的 Type C (M)。
paragraphs.ms: Jenis C ialah suite dual key dengan ruang tamu dan makan, satu bilik dan dua bilik mandi dalam 657 kaki persegi. Ia susun atur paling banyak, dengan 377 unit, dan turut ada versi cermin, Jenis C (M).
paragraphs.ja: Type C は657平方フィートのデュアルキーで、リビング・ダイニング、1部屋、バス2つ。377戸と最も多い間取りで、左右反転の Type C (M) もあります。
paragraphs.ko: Type C는 657평방피트 듀얼키로 거실과 식사 공간, 방 1개, 욕실 2개가 있습니다. 377세대로 가장 많은 타입이며, 좌우 반전형 Type C (M)도 있습니다.

paragraphs.en: A dual-key unit has two doors, so the owner can live in one part and rent out the other, or rent both. The maintenance fee is about RM650 a month.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 双钥匙单位有两个门，业主可以自住一边、出租另一边，或两边都出租。管理费每月约 RM650。
paragraphs.ms: Unit dual key mempunyai dua pintu, jadi pemilik boleh tinggal di satu bahagian dan menyewakan bahagian lain, atau menyewakan kedua-duanya. Yuran penyelenggaraan kira-kira RM650 sebulan.
paragraphs.ja: デュアルキーは入口が2つあるので、片方に住んでもう片方を貸す、または両方を貸すことができます。管理費は月約 RM650 です。
paragraphs.ko: 듀얼키는 출입문이 2개라서 한쪽에 살고 다른 쪽을 임대하거나, 둘 다 임대할 수 있습니다. 관리비는 월 약 RM650입니다.

h2.en: Monthly cost: an example for Type A
h2.zh-CN: 每月开销：以 Type A 为例
h2.ms: Kos bulanan: contoh untuk Jenis A
h2.ja: 毎月のコスト：Type A の例

paragraphs.en: At RM699,000 with a 90% loan over 35 years at an example rate of 4.2%, the monthly instalment is about RM2,861. Add the maintenance fee of about RM320 and the monthly cost is about RM3,181. The interest rate is only an example, so check the rate your bank offers.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 以 RM699,000、贷款 90%、35 年、利率 4.2%（只是例子）计算，每月供期约 RM2,861。加上每月约 RM320 的管理费，每月开销约 RM3,181。实际利率请以银行为准。
paragraphs.ms: Pada harga RM699,000 dengan pinjaman 90% selama 35 tahun pada kadar contoh 4.2%, ansuran bulanan kira-kira RM2,861. Tambah yuran penyelenggaraan kira-kira RM320 dan kos bulanan kira-kira RM3,181. Kadar faedah hanya contoh, jadi semak kadar yang ditawarkan bank anda.
paragraphs.ja: RM699,000、ローン90%、35年、金利4.2%（一例）で計算すると、毎月の返済は約 RM2,861。管理費約 RM320 を加えると、毎月のコストは約 RM3,181 です。金利は一例なので、銀行の条件をご確認ください。
paragraphs.ko: RM699,000, 대출 90%, 35년, 금리 4.2%(예시)로 계산하면 월 상환액은 약 RM2,861입니다. 관리비 약 RM320을 더하면 월 비용은 약 RM3,181입니다. 금리는 예시이니 은행 조건을 확인하세요.

paragraphs.en: Prices for Type B and Type C depend on the tower and floor. WhatsApp Keith for the current prices of the units you like.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type B 和 Type C 的价格要看楼栋和楼层。喜欢哪个单位，可以 WhatsApp Keith 查最新价格。
paragraphs.ms: Harga Jenis B dan Jenis C bergantung pada menara dan tingkat. WhatsApp Keith untuk harga terkini unit yang anda minati.
paragraphs.ja: Type B と Type C の価格は棟と階によって異なります。気になる住戸の最新価格は Keith に WhatsApp でお問い合わせください。
paragraphs.ko: Type B와 Type C의 가격은 동과 층에 따라 다릅니다. 마음에 드는 세대의 최신 가격은 Keith에게 WhatsApp으로 문의하세요.

paragraphs.en: Choose Type A for the lowest entry price or a city-centre office, Type B if you want a separate room for yourself, and Type C if you want the flexibility of two doors. Whichever you choose, check the exact unit, floor and price before you book.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 想要最低入场价或市中心办公室，选 Type A；想要自己的独立房间，选 Type B；想要两个门的弹性，选 Type C。不管选哪个，下订前都要确认实际单位、楼层和价格。
paragraphs.ms: Pilih Jenis A untuk harga permulaan terendah atau pejabat di pusat bandar, Jenis B jika anda mahukan bilik berasingan, dan Jenis C jika anda mahukan fleksibiliti dua pintu. Apa pun pilihan anda, semak unit, tingkat dan harga sebenar sebelum menempah.
paragraphs.ja: 最も手頃な価格や都心のオフィスなら Type A、自分の個室が欲しいなら Type B、入口2つの柔軟さが欲しいなら Type C。どれを選んでも、予約前に実際の住戸、階、価格を確認してください。
paragraphs.ko: 가장 낮은 가격이나 도심 사무실을 원하면 Type A, 별도의 방을 원하면 Type B, 출입문 2개의 유연함을 원하면 Type C를 고르세요. 어떤 타입이든 예약 전에 실제 세대, 층, 가격을 확인하세요.

label.zh-CN: Type C 双钥匙，377 个单位
label.ja: Type C デュアルキー、377戸

takeaway.en: The right layout depends on your plan: the lowest entry price, a separate room, or a dual key you can split. Tell me how you plan to use the unit and I will suggest the type and floor that fit.
takeaway.zh-CN: 选哪个户型，要看你的计划：最低入场价、独立房间，还是可以分开使用的双钥匙。告诉我你打算怎么用这个单位，我帮你建议合适的户型和楼层。
takeaway.ms: Susun atur yang sesuai bergantung pada rancangan anda: harga permulaan terendah, bilik berasingan, atau dual key yang boleh dibahagikan. Beritahu saya bagaimana anda mahu menggunakan unit ini dan saya akan cadangkan jenis dan tingkat yang sesuai.
takeaway.ja: どの間取りが合うかは計画次第です。最も手頃な価格、個室、分けて使えるデュアルキー。住戸の使い方を教えていただければ、合うタイプと階をご提案します。
takeaway.ko: 어떤 타입이 맞는지는 계획에 달려 있습니다. 가장 낮은 가격, 별도의 방, 나눠 쓸 수 있는 듀얼키. 어떻게 사용할 계획인지 알려 주시면 맞는 타입과 층을 추천해 드리겠습니다.

title.en: Clouthaus: Is It Worth Buying? A Plain Guide for Buyers
title.zh-CN: Clouthaus 值得买吗？给买家的简单分析

intro.en: Clouthaus is a freehold residential project by TA Global on Jalan P. Ramlee, about 30 steps from the Petronas Twin Towers. Here is what you get, who it suits and what to compare before you decide.
intro.zh-CN: Clouthaus 是 TA Global 在 Jalan P. Ramlee 开发的永久地契住宅项目，离 Petronas 双子塔大约 30 步。这篇整理了项目内容、适合哪些买家，以及决定前可以比较的地方。

paragraphs.en: Clouthaus is developed by TA Global Bhd across two connected residential blocks on Jalan P. Ramlee, inside the KL City Centre precinct. The land is freehold, which is uncommon for a new project this close to the Twin Towers. Completion is scheduled for Q1 2029.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Clouthaus 由 TA Global Bhd 开发，是 Jalan P. Ramlee 上两栋相连的住宅楼，位于 KL City Centre 区内。项目是永久地契，在双子塔这么近的新项目里并不多见。预计 2029 年第一季完工。

paragraphs.en: TA Global has also marketed Clouthaus overseas, including in Singapore, and told EdgeProp that its buyers come from more than 20 nationalities.
paragraphs.zh-CN: TA Global 也在海外推广 Clouthaus，包括新加坡。发展商告诉 EdgeProp，项目买家来自超过 20 个国家。

paragraphs.en: The address is the main reason buyers look at Clouthaus. Suria KL City Centre, the Petronas Twin Towers and KL City Centre Park are a short walk away, and the KL City Centre and Ampang Park LRT stations are both nearby.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 地点是买家看 Clouthaus 的主要原因。Suria KL City Centre、Petronas 双子塔和 KL City Centre 公园都在步行范围内，附近也有 KL City Centre 和 Ampang Park 两个 LRT 站。

paragraphs.en: Jalan P. Ramlee also puts you close to the offices, hotels and restaurants of the Golden Triangle, with Bukit Bintang a short drive away.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Jalan P. Ramlee 一带靠近金三角的办公楼、酒店和餐厅，开车到 Bukit Bintang 也很快。

paragraphs.en: There are 11 layouts from 549 to 1,216 sqft: compact 1-bedroom units of 549 and 635 sqft, larger 1-bedroom units with two bathrooms from 893 to 1,173 sqft, 2-bedroom units from 904 to 980 sqft, and 3-bedroom units of 1,119 and 1,216 sqft.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 共有 11 种户型，面积 549 至 1,216 平方尺：549 和 635 平方尺的精致 1 房；893 至 1,173 平方尺、2 间浴室的大 1 房；904 至 980 平方尺的 2 房；以及 1,119 和 1,216 平方尺的 3 房。

paragraphs.en: Prices start from about RM1.41 million. Prices differ by tower, floor and layout, so ask for the current price list for the exact units you like.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 价格大约从 RM141 万起。价格按楼栋、楼层和户型不同，喜欢哪个单位，要问最新的价格表。

paragraphs.en: Clouthaus suits buyers who want a freehold home in the heart of KL City Centre, professionals who work around the Twin Towers, and families or upgraders who need a 2- or 3-bedroom unit in the city. It also suits foreign buyers looking for a well-known city address: entry prices are above the RM1 million minimum for foreigners in Kuala Lumpur.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Clouthaus 适合想在 KL City Centre 中心拥有永久地契单位的买家、在双子塔一带上班的专业人士，以及需要市中心 2 房或 3 房的家庭和换屋买家。它也适合想找知名城市地址的外国买家：入门价格已超过吉隆坡外国人 RM100 万的最低价格。

h2.en: What to compare before you decide
h2.zh-CN: 决定前可以比较的地方

paragraphs.en: Most layouts are 1 bedroom, and only two layouts have 3 bedrooms, so families should check which family units are still available. Completion is Q1 2029, so match it with when you need the home.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 大部分户型是 1 房，3 房只有两种户型，家庭买家要先确认还剩哪些家庭户型。完工期是 2029 年第一季，看看是否配合你需要入住的时间。

paragraphs.en: Compare the total price and price per sqft with other freehold projects in KL City Centre, and ask about the maintenance fee and car park for your unit.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 可以和 KL City Centre 其他永久地契项目比较总价和每平方尺价格，也要问清楚你那个单位的管理费和车位。

takeaway.en: For me, Clouthaus is about the address: freehold land a short walk from the Twin Towers is hard to find. If a city-centre home fits your plan, it is worth a close look. WhatsApp me and I will check the current prices and units for you.
takeaway.zh-CN: 对我来说，Clouthaus 最大的价值是地址：离双子塔步行就到的永久地契地段很难找。如果市中心的家符合你的计划，值得仔细看看。WhatsApp 我，我帮你查最新价格和剩余单位。

title.en: Clouthaus Layouts: 1, 2 or 3 Bedrooms, Which One Fits You?
title.zh-CN: Clouthaus 户型怎么选？1 房、2 房还是 3 房

intro.en: Clouthaus has 11 layouts, from a 549 sqft 1-bedroom to a 1,216 sqft 3-bedroom. They fall into four groups, so here is a simple way to choose.
intro.zh-CN: Clouthaus 有 11 种户型，从 549 平方尺的 1 房到 1,216 平方尺的 3 房，可以分成四类。这篇用简单的方法帮你选。

h2.zh-CN: 精致 1 房：549 和 635 平方尺

paragraphs.en: Types C, D, E and F (549 sqft) have open living and dining with a separate kitchen. Type K (635 sqft) adds a study nook off the kitchen. These are the entry layouts and suit a single professional or a buyer who wants the lowest entry price.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type C、D、E、F（549 平方尺）有开放式客厅和饭厅，厨房独立。Type K（635 平方尺）在厨房旁多了一个小书桌位。这些是入门户型，适合单身专业人士，或想要最低入场价的买家。

h2.en: Large 1 bedroom with 2 bathrooms: 893 to 1,173 sqft
h2.zh-CN: 大 1 房、2 浴室：893 至 1,173 平方尺

paragraphs.en: Types N (893 sqft), J (1,001 sqft), B (1,098 sqft) and M (1,173 sqft) are 1-bedroom homes with two bathrooms and a foyer; Types B and M also have a study. They suit couples who want space without a second bedroom, or someone who works from home.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type N（893 平方尺）、J（1,001 平方尺）、B（1,098 平方尺）和 M（1,173 平方尺）是有 2 间浴室和玄关的 1 房；Type B 和 M 另有书房。适合想要宽敞空间但不需要第二间房的情侣，或在家工作的人。

paragraphs.en: Type G (904 sqft) is a corner layout with a curved living and dining frontage, Type H (904 sqft) has a master ensuite and a separate family bathroom, and Type L (980 sqft) adds a study nook. These suit couples who need a guest room or a small family.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type G（904 平方尺）是转角户型，客厅饭厅有弧形景观面；Type H（904 平方尺）有主卧套房和独立家庭浴室；Type L（980 平方尺）多了书桌位。适合需要客房的情侣或小家庭。

paragraphs.en: Type I (1,119 sqft) is a corner 3-bedroom with a master ensuite, and Type A (1,216 sqft) is the largest layout, with a utility room. These are the family homes, and there are only two of these layout types.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type I（1,119 平方尺）是转角 3 房，有主卧套房；Type A（1,216 平方尺）是最大的户型，附工人房。这两种是家庭户型，而且只有这两种。

paragraphs.en: Start with how many bedrooms you need, then choose between size and price within that group. Because the layouts vary a lot within the same bedroom count, compare the floor plans side by side and check the exact unit, floor and price before you book.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 先决定需要几间房，再在同一类里比较面积和价格。同样房数的户型差别也很大，最好把户型图放在一起比较，下订前确认实际单位、楼层和价格。

takeaway.en: Tell me how many people will live in the home or how you plan to use it, and I will send you the two or three layouts that fit, with their floor plans and the latest prices.
takeaway.zh-CN: 告诉我几个人住、打算怎么用这个单位，我会发给你最合适的两三个户型，附户型图和最新价格。

title.en: Golden Crown Residence: Is It Worth Buying? A Plain Guide
title.zh-CN: Golden Crown Residence 值得买吗？项目简单分析

intro.en: Golden Crown Residence is a 60-storey tower on Jalan Tun Razak, right beside the Tun Razak Exchange (TRX), with an underground link to the TRX MRT interchange. Here is what you get, who it suits and what to compare.
intro.zh-CN: Golden Crown Residence 是 Jalan Tun Razak 上一栋 60 层的住宅楼，就在 Tun Razak Exchange（TRX）旁边，有地下通道连接 TRX MRT 转换站。这篇整理了项目内容、适合谁，以及可以比较的地方。

h2.zh-CN: Golden Crown Residence 是什么项目

paragraphs.en: Golden Crown Residence, by Golden Eagle Group, has 490 units in a 60-storey tower, part of a 2-acre mixed-use site with hotel and office towers. There are 10 to 11 units per floor served by four lifts and one service lift.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Golden Crown Residence 由 Golden Eagle Group 开发，一栋 60 层楼，共 490 个单位，属于一个 2 英亩的综合发展，旁边还有酒店和办公楼。每层 10 至 11 个单位，有 4 部电梯和 1 部服务电梯。

paragraphs.en: The tenure is leasehold, expiring in 2111, and the target completion is December 2026. Units come partly furnished, including kitchen cabinets, hob and hood, oven, fridge, washer-dryer, air-conditioning, wardrobes and a water heater.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 地契是租赁地契，到 2111 年，目标在 2026 年 12 月完工。单位附部分家具，包括厨柜、炉灶和抽油烟机、烤箱、冰箱、洗衣烘干机、冷气、衣柜和热水器。

paragraphs.en: The tower has an underground connection to the TRX MRT 1 and 2 interchange and The Exchange TRX mall. The TRX park is about 50m away, Exchange 106 about 130m, Prince Court Medical Centre about 600m and Pavilion KL about 1km.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 大楼有地下通道连接 TRX 的 MRT 1 号和 2 号线转换站，以及 The Exchange TRX 商场。TRX 公园约 50 米，Exchange 106 约 130 米，Prince Court 医疗中心约 600 米，Pavilion KL 约 1 公里。

paragraphs.en: By road, Jalan Tun Razak, the SMART Tunnel, MEX and SPE highways are close by, and EtonHouse International School is about 1km away.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 开车方面，Jalan Tun Razak、SMART 隧道、MEX 和 SPE 大道都很近，EtonHouse 国际学校约 1 公里。

paragraphs.en: There are six layouts from 624 to 1,023 sqft: 1-bedroom Types A1 (624 sqft) and A2 (732 sqft, with a balcony), 2-bedroom Types B1, B2 (926 sqft) and B3 (958 sqft), and a 1,023 sqft dual-key Type C.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 共有 6 种户型，面积 624 至 1,023 平方尺：1 房的 Type A1（624 平方尺）和 A2（732 平方尺，有阳台）；2 房的 Type B1、B2（926 平方尺）和 B3（958 平方尺）；以及 1,023 平方尺的双钥匙 Type C。

paragraphs.en: Prices start from RM1,280,000 (gross), from about RM2,051 per sqft. Sky facilities on Levels 58 and 59 include an infinity pool, wading pool, BBQ terrace, gym, library and games room.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 价格从 RM1,280,000 起（Gross），每平方尺约 RM2,051 起。第 58 和 59 层的空中设施有无边泳池、浅水池、烧烤台、健身房、图书室和游戏室。

paragraphs.en: It suits professionals who work in TRX or the city centre and want a train link at their doorstep, couples who want a partly furnished home, and small families who need a 2-bedroom unit near international schools. The dual-key Type C suits owners who want two separate entrances.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 适合在 TRX 或市中心上班、想要家门口就有地铁的专业人士；想要附部分家具单位的情侣；以及需要 2 房、靠近国际学校的小家庭。双钥匙的 Type C 适合想要两个独立入口的业主。

h2.en: What to compare before you decide
h2.zh-CN: 决定前可以比较的地方

paragraphs.en: The tenure is leasehold to 2111, so compare it with freehold options nearby. The maintenance fee is about RM0.80 per sqft, around RM500 a month for Type A1. Most units come with one car park, except 30 Type A1 units on Levels 13 to 22.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 地契是租赁地契到 2111 年，可以和附近的永久地契项目比较。管理费约每平方尺 RM0.80，Type A1 每月约 RM500。大部分单位附 1 个车位，只有第 13 至 22 层的 30 个 Type A1 没有。

paragraphs.en: Entry prices are above the RM1 million minimum for foreign buyers in Kuala Lumpur.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 入门价格已经超过吉隆坡外国买家 RM100 万的最低价格。

takeaway.en: What sets Golden Crown apart is the underground link to the TRX MRT interchange: you can reach the train and The Exchange TRX without crossing a road. With completion targeted for December 2026, it suits buyers who do not want to wait years. WhatsApp me for the units still available.
takeaway.zh-CN: Golden Crown 最大的特点是地下通道直通 TRX MRT 转换站：不用过马路就能到地铁站和 The Exchange TRX。目标在 2026 年 12 月完工，适合不想等好几年的买家。WhatsApp 我，查还有哪些单位。

title.en: Golden Crown Residence Layouts: Which One Fits You?
title.zh-CN: Golden Crown Residence 户型怎么选？哪个适合你

intro.en: Golden Crown Residence has six layouts, from a 624 sqft 1-bedroom to a 1,023 sqft dual-key unit. Here is a side-by-side look at each, with the monthly maintenance fee at about RM0.80 per sqft.
intro.zh-CN: Golden Crown Residence 有 6 种户型，从 624 平方尺的 1 房到 1,023 平方尺的双钥匙单位。这篇逐一比较，管理费按每平方尺约 RM0.80 计算。

h2.zh-CN: Type A1：624 平方尺，1 房

paragraphs.en: A compact 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home with open living, dining and kitchen, and the entry point from RM1,280,000. The maintenance fee is about RM499 a month. Note that 30 Type A1 units on Levels 13 to 22 come without a car park.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 精致的 1 房 1 浴，开放式客厅、饭厅和厨房，是 RM1,280,000 起的入门户型。管理费每月约 RM499。第 13 至 22 层有 30 个 Type A1 不附车位，要留意。

h2.en: Type A2: 732 sqft, 1 bedroom with balcony
h2.zh-CN: Type A2：732 平方尺，1 房附阳台

paragraphs.en: A 1-bedroom home with a private balcony off the living area, available in limited units on Levels 13 to 47. The maintenance fee is about RM586 a month.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 1 房单位，客厅外有私人阳台，只在第 13 至 47 层，数量有限。管理费每月约 RM586。

h2.en: Types B1, B2 and B3: 926 to 958 sqft, 2 bedrooms
h2.zh-CN: Type B1、B2、B3：926 至 958 平方尺，2 房

paragraphs.en: Three 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom layouts, each with a utility room. B1 has a wide living and dining area, B2 has a master suite with open living and kitchen, and B3 is slightly larger at 958 sqft. The maintenance fee is about RM741 a month for B1 and B2 and RM766 for B3.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 三种 2 房 2 浴的户型，都有工人房。B1 客厅饭厅较宽；B2 有主卧套房，客厅和厨房开放；B3 稍大，958 平方尺。管理费每月 B1、B2 约 RM741，B3 约 RM766。

h2.zh-CN: Type C：1,023 平方尺双钥匙

paragraphs.en: A dual-key layout with a separate entrance, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a utility room. It suits multi-generational families or owners who want two separate spaces. The maintenance fee is about RM818 a month.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 双钥匙户型，有独立入口，2 房 2 浴附工人房。适合多代同住的家庭，或想要两个独立空间的业主。管理费每月约 RM818。

paragraphs.en: Choose Type A1 for the lowest entry price, Type A2 if you want a balcony, a B type for a 2-bedroom family home, and Type C if you want two separate entrances. Check the floor, the view and whether a car park is included before you book.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 想要最低入场价选 Type A1；想要阳台选 Type A2；需要 2 房的家选 B 类；想要两个独立入口选 Type C。下订前要确认楼层、景观，以及是否附车位。

takeaway.en: Tell me who will live in the unit and whether you drive, and I will suggest the layout and floor that fit, with the latest prices.
takeaway.zh-CN: 告诉我谁会住、需不需要车位，我帮你建议合适的户型和楼层，并附上最新价格。

title.en: Zenia @ ParkCity Damansara: Is It Worth Buying? A Plain Guide
title.zh-CN: Zenia @ ParkCity Damansara 值得买吗？项目简单分析

intro.en: Zenia is the first residential launch in ParkCity Damansara, a new township in Petaling Jaya by the developer of Desa ParkCity. Here is what you get, who it suits and what to compare before you decide.
intro.zh-CN: Zenia 是 ParkCity Damansara 的第一个住宅项目。ParkCity Damansara 是 Desa ParkCity 发展商在 Petaling Jaya 打造的新城镇。这篇整理了项目内容、适合谁，以及决定前可以比较的地方。

paragraphs.en: Zenia is a 55-acre enclave with 1,085 homes: 442 three-storey ParkHomes and 643 Condovillas in five blocks of 9 to 23 storeys. At about 20 homes per acre, it is a low-density development set beside a hill and a pond.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Zenia 占地 55 英亩，共 1,085 个单位：442 间三层楼的 ParkHome，以及分布在 5 栋 9 至 23 层楼里的 643 个 Condovilla。每英亩大约只有 20 个单位，是低密度项目，旁边有小山和湖。

paragraphs.en: It is developed by ParkCity Group, known for Desa ParkCity in Kuala Lumpur. The tenure is leasehold until 2124, and completion is expected in 2030.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 发展商是 ParkCity Group，也就是吉隆坡 Desa ParkCity 的发展商。地契是租赁地契到 2124 年，预计 2030 年完工。

paragraphs.en: Zenia is in ParkCity Damansara, near Kota Damansara MRT station and Menara KWSP. Sunway Giza Mall, IOI Mall Damansara and Seri Selangor Golf Club are nearby, and so are Thomson Hospital and Sunway Specialist Centre Damansara.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Zenia 位于 ParkCity Damansara，靠近 Kota Damansara MRT 站和 Menara KWSP。附近有 Sunway Giza Mall、IOI Mall Damansara 和 Seri Selangor 高尔夫球场，也有 Thomson 医院和 Sunway Specialist Centre Damansara。

paragraphs.en: St. Joseph's Institution International School is close by, which matters for families.
paragraphs.zh-CN: St. Joseph's Institution 国际学校就在附近，对家庭买家很重要。

paragraphs.en: Condovillas have 3 to 5 bedrooms from 1,691 to 4,247 sqft, each with a private lobby, and start from about RM1.3 million. ParkHomes are three-storey homes of 3,150 to 3,980 sqft with 4 to 6 bedrooms, a family lounge and a car porch, from about RM2.5 million.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Condovilla 有 3 至 5 房，面积 1,691 至 4,247 平方尺，每户都有私人电梯厅，大约从 RM130 万起。ParkHome 是三层楼的房子，面积 3,150 至 3,980 平方尺，4 至 6 房，有家庭厅和车廊，大约从 RM250 万起。

paragraphs.en: The facilities deck has a main pool, family pool and kids pool, a reading and work loft, BBQ pavilion, multipurpose hall, multi court, outdoor fitness and a kindergarten.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 设施平台有主泳池、家庭泳池和儿童泳池、阅读与工作阁楼、烧烤亭、多用途礼堂、多用途球场、户外健身区和幼儿园。

paragraphs.en: Zenia suits families who want space, from a 3-bedroom Condovilla to a 6-bedroom ParkHome, upgraders moving from a smaller condo, and buyers who value a low-density, township setting with schools and hospitals nearby.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Zenia 适合想要大空间的家庭，从 3 房的 Condovilla 到 6 房的 ParkHome 都有；也适合从小公寓换大屋的买家，以及重视低密度、附近有学校和医院的城镇环境的人。

h2.en: What to compare before you decide
h2.zh-CN: 决定前可以比较的地方

paragraphs.en: Completion is expected in 2030, so it suits buyers who can wait. The tenure is leasehold until 2124. The Condovilla maintenance fee is about RM0.33 per sqft before the sinking fund, around RM560 a month for the 1,691 sqft Type A1.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 预计 2030 年完工，适合可以等的买家。地契是租赁地契到 2124 年。Condovilla 管理费约每平方尺 RM0.33（不含维修基金），1,691 平方尺的 Type A1 每月约 RM560。

paragraphs.en: For foreign buyers, the minimum price in Selangor is RM2 million: ParkHomes start above it, while the entry Condovillas are below it, so check the exact unit first.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 外国买家在雪兰莪的最低价格是 RM200 万：ParkHome 的起价已经超过，入门的 Condovilla 则低于这个价格，要先确认实际单位。

takeaway.en: Zenia is for buyers who want space and a planned township from an experienced township developer. If you can wait for 2030, it is worth comparing a large Condovilla with a ParkHome. WhatsApp me and I will send you both floor plans and the latest prices.
takeaway.zh-CN: Zenia 适合想要大空间、又看重有经验的城镇发展商的买家。如果你可以等到 2030 年，值得把大 Condovilla 和 ParkHome 放在一起比较。WhatsApp 我，我发两种户型图和最新价格给你。

title.en: Zenia: Condovilla or ParkHome? Which Layout Fits You
title.zh-CN: Zenia 选 Condovilla 还是 ParkHome？哪个户型适合你

intro.en: Zenia offers two kinds of homes: Condovillas in five blocks and three-storey ParkHomes. Here is how the main types compare by size, rooms and running costs.
intro.zh-CN: Zenia 有两种单位：5 栋楼里的 Condovilla，以及三层楼的 ParkHome。这篇比较主要户型的面积、房间和日常开销。

h2.zh-CN: Condovilla Type A：1,691 平方尺，3 房

paragraphs.en: The most accessible Condovilla: 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms with a private lobby, and the largest group with 269 units. Garden variants reach 2,013 sqft. The maintenance fee is about RM558 a month before the sinking fund.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 最容易入手的 Condovilla：3 房 3 浴，有私人电梯厅，数量最多，共 269 个。附花园的版本可达 2,013 平方尺。管理费每月约 RM558（不含维修基金）。

h2.zh-CN: Condovilla Type B：2,053 平方尺，3 房

paragraphs.en: A larger 3-bedroom home with 4 bathrooms and a utility room, in two layouts (B1 and B2). It suits families who want every bedroom with its own bathroom. The maintenance fee is about RM677 a month.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 较大的 3 房，有 4 间浴室和工人房，有 B1 和 B2 两种格局。适合想要每间房都有浴室的家庭。管理费每月约 RM677。

h2.en: Condovilla Types C and D: 3,095 to 3,691 sqft
h2.zh-CN: Condovilla Type C 和 D：3,095 至 3,691 平方尺

paragraphs.en: Type C1 (3,095 sqft) has 4 bedrooms and a powder room, Type C2 (3,657 sqft) adds a study and wrap-around balconies, and the duplex Type D1 (3,691 sqft) has 5 bedrooms, a family room and an outdoor deck, with only 2 units.
paragraphs.zh-CN: Type C1（3,095 平方尺）是 4 房附化妆间；Type C2（3,657 平方尺）多了书房和环绕阳台；复式的 Type D1（3,691 平方尺）有 5 房、家庭厅和户外平台，只有 2 个单位。

paragraphs.en: Three-storey homes with a family lounge and car porch. Intermediate units (Types A1 and B1, 3,150 to 3,210 sqft) have 4 bedrooms; end lots (Types A2 and B2, 3,820 to 3,980 sqft) have 5 bedrooms. Type A homes have 2 side-by-side car parks; Type B homes have 1 single plus 2 tandem.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 三层楼的房子，有家庭厅和车廊。中间单位（Type A1 和 B1，3,150 至 3,210 平方尺）是 4 房；角头单位（Type A2 和 B2，3,820 至 3,980 平方尺）是 5 房。Type A 有 2 个并排车位；Type B 有 1 个单车位加 2 个前后车位。

paragraphs.en: Choose a Condovilla if you want lift access, a private lobby and lower upkeep, and a ParkHome if you want a landed feel with your own car porch. Compare a large Condovilla with an intermediate ParkHome, since their sizes and prices can be close.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 想要电梯、私人电梯厅和较少打理，选 Condovilla；想要有地屋的感觉和自己的车廊，选 ParkHome。可以把大 Condovilla 和中间 ParkHome 放在一起比较，两者的面积和价格可能很接近。

takeaway.en: Tell me how many people will live in the home and whether you prefer lifts or stairs, and I will suggest the type that fits, with the floor plans and latest prices.
takeaway.zh-CN: 告诉我几个人住、比较喜欢电梯还是楼梯，我帮你建议合适的户型，并附上户型图和最新价格。
